summary_1line: Bhishma overwhelms the Pandava forces, duels Yudhishthira, destroys his chariot, and continues slaughter despite being surrounded until Sikhandin advances toward him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands on his chariot releasing a storm of arrows that darken the sky and render Yudhishthira invisible.
Bhishma cuts down Yudhishthira’s golden-decked horses, leaving the king forced to leap onto Nakula’s chariot.
Surrounded by many chariots, Bhishma fights like a lone lion among deer, severed warrior heads falling to the earth like fruit.
